the geometry of the x-ray fluorescence spectrometer is a critical factor for the accuracy of the analysis, and that the distance between the sample and the detector is particularly critical.

the geometry of the excitation-source-to-sample distance and sample-to-detector distance is crucial for obtaining a correct result in x-ray fluorescence analysis.
